item.description: Choose the images that you would like to appear in the image gallery.
item.label: Images

item.description: Select an ordering method for the gallery. This controls which gallery items appear first in the list.
item.label: Image Order

item.description:
Choose the orientation of the gallery thumbnails.
Note: If this option appears to have no effect, you might need to regenerate your thumbnails.
item.label: Thumbnail Orientation

item.description: If you would like the slider to slide automatically, without the visitor having to click the next button, enable this option and then adjust the rotation speed below if desired.
item.label: Automatic Animation

item.description: Here you can designate how fast the slider fades between each slide, if 'Automatic Animation' option is enabled above. The higher the number the longer the pause between each rotation.
item.label: Automatic Animation Speed (in ms)

item.description: Toggle between the various gallery layout types.
item.label: Layout

item.description: Define the number of images that should be displayed per page.
item.label: Image Count

item.description: Whether or not to show the title and caption for images (if available).
item.label: Show Title and Caption

item.description: Here you can define a custom color for the overlay
item.label: Overlay Background Color

item.description: Here you can define a custom color for the zoom icon.
item.label: Overlay Icon Color

icon.description: Here you can define a custom icon for the overlay
icon.label: Overlay Icon

item.description: Whether or not to show pagination for the gallery.
item.label: Show Pagination

module.description: Grid or slider of images displayed in a clickable thumbnail layout.
module.name: divi/gallery
module.title: Gallery
